description: Represents a motor insurance claim from initial submission through assessment, review, settlement, and closure. Stores the business state used by UiPath Maestro to orchestrate automated activities, AI decisions, and human actions throughout the claim lifecycle.

fields.name: ClaimAmount
fields.description: Amount claimed by the customer.

fields.name: ClaimId
fields.description: Unique business identifier for the insurance claim, such as CLM-1001.

fields.name: CustomerName
fields.description: Full name of the customer or policyholder submitting the claim.

fields.name: IncidentDate
fields.description: Date on which the accident or insured incident occurred.

fields.name: IncidentDescription
fields.description: Customer-provided description of the accident or incident.

fields.name: PolicyNumber
fields.description: Insurance policy number associated with the claim.

fields.name: VehicleModel
fields.description: Make and model of the insured vehicle.

fields.name: VehicleRegistration
fields.description: Vehicle registration number associated with the claim.

fields.name: DocumentReferences
fields.description: One document reference per line in the format DocumentType=StoragePath. This stores the files associated with the claim without putting ClaimId into filenames.

fields.name: DocumentIngestionStatus
fields.description: Lifecycle state of document ingestion, such as Received, Extracted, or Failed.

fields.name: ExtractedCustomerName
fields.description: Customer name extracted from submitted documents.

fields.name: ExtractedPolicyNumber
fields.description: Policy number extracted from submitted documents.

fields.name: ExtractedVehicleRegistration
fields.description: Vehicle registration extracted from submitted documents.

fields.name: ExtractedIncidentDate
fields.description: Incident date extracted from submitted documents.

fields.name: ExtractedDocumentTypes
fields.description: Document types successfully identified in the submission package.

fields.name: ExtractedRepairEstimate
fields.description: Repair estimate amount extracted from an estimate document, when present.

fields.name: PolicyValid
fields.description: Indicates whether policy validation passed.

fields.name: PolicyValidationReason
fields.description: Explanation produced by policy validation.

fields.name: DocumentsComplete
fields.description: Indicates whether the required initial document package is complete.

fields.name: MissingDocuments
fields.description: List of required documents that are not yet available.

fields.name: FraudScore
fields.description: Fraud risk score produced by the fraud assessment agent.

fields.name: RiskLevel
fields.description: Risk classification such as Low, Medium, or High.

fields.name: FraudFlag
fields.description: Indicates whether the fraud assessment requires an investigation.

fields.name: FraudReasons
fields.description: Signals and inconsistencies identified by the fraud assessment agent.

fields.name: DamageEstimate
fields.description: Estimated repair or damage value produced by damage assessment.

fields.name: AdjusterDecision
fields.description: Adjuster decision such as Approve, Reject, or RequestInformation.

fields.name: AdjusterComments
fields.description: Adjuster review comments.

fields.name: AdditionalInformationRequested
fields.description: Information requested from the customer when the claim cannot proceed.

fields.name: CustomerInformationStatus
fields.description: Status such as NotRequired, Requested, Received, or Rejected.

fields.name: CustomerResponseDate
fields.description: Date the customer response or supplemental information was received.

fields.name: ReceivedDocumentReference
fields.description: Reference for the latest supplemental document received from the customer.

fields.name: FraudInvestigationResult
fields.description: Investigation outcome such as Cleared or Confirmed.

fields.name: FraudInvestigationComments
fields.description: Fraud investigation findings and comments.

fields.name: SeniorApprovalRequired
fields.description: Indicates whether settlement requires senior approval.

fields.name: SeniorApprovalDecision
fields.description: Senior approval decision such as Approved or Rejected.

fields.name: SeniorApprovalComments
fields.description: Senior approval comments.

fields.name: SettlementAmount
fields.description: Final amount approved for settlement.

fields.name: SettlementStatus
fields.description: Settlement status such as Pending, Processed, or Failed.

fields.name: PaymentReference
fields.description: Reference returned by the simulated settlement process.

fields.name: SettlementDate
fields.description: Date settlement payment was processed.

fields.name: ClaimPacketReference
fields.description: Reference to the generated claim packet.

fields.name: NotificationStatus
fields.description: Customer notification status.

fields.name: ClaimOutcome
fields.description: Final outcome such as Settled, Denied, Withdrawn, or Closed.

fields.name: ClaimStatus
fields.description: Current business lifecycle status of the claim.

fields.name: DocumentInconsistencies
fields.description: Material conflicts between claim documents, written by ClaimDocumentIntelligence and read by FraudRiskAssessment.
